name: 34228 · Longboat Key, FL
findings: ZIP 34228 (Longboat Key) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34228 (Longboat Key) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34228 (Longboat Key) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 14% of all organizations here have no identified type.
